$description: Single source of truth for the Steel Reconciliation Platform frontend. Consumed by theme.ts (MUI createTheme) and tokens.css (CSS custom properties). See design.md for specs and brandguidelines.md for rationale. BRAND-ANCHORED to My Home Group (red + black/ink + white). Neutral-forward premium (Apple/Google discipline): ink + clean zinc-neutral do ~85% of the UI; My Home red is the one confident accent (brand, primary CTA, active, focus, selection). Color is SYSTEMATIC — `ramp` holds Material-3 HCT tonal scales; roles derive from stops (see `_derivation`). Danger uses the logo's DARKER maroon-red (distinct from brand red) + always an icon, so brand-red and alert-red never collide. All `_meta` contrasts meet WCAG 2.2 AA.

ramp._note: Reference layer. Generated via @material/material-color-utilities (HCT). Seeds: red(brand) #E4002B, danger(maroon) #9A1B1B, steel(info) #2A5A85, success #15803D, warning #A16207; neutral = hue 250 / chroma 2 (crisp zinc-like cool gray). 50=lightest, 950=darkest.

_derivation._note: Roles derive from ramp stops. ink = neutral (near-black actions/text); brand = My Home red accent; info = steel (links). Only dark 'subtle' tints are hand-set. Brand CTA fill uses red-600 (white text 5.36:1) — NOT red-500 (fails AA).
_derivation.light.ink: default=neutral tone20, hover=neutral14, active=neutral~10, subtle=neutral100, border=neutral strong
_derivation.light.brand: default=red600, hover=red700, active=red800, subtle=red50, border=red200, text=red700
_derivation.light.surface/text: neutral — app=97, card=#fff, sunken=94, hair=90, strong=80, text primary=14/secondary=40/tertiary=45
_derivation.dark: ink=light neutral fill; brand text=red400 (5.54:1 on card); brand CTA still red600; semantics=ramp300; subtle tints hand-set

dark._note: Deep zinc charcoal; ink buttons become light fills; brand CTA stays red-600; brand text uses red-400; subtle tints hand-set.

radius._note: Apple-philosophy: slightly larger, continuous-feel radii on surfaces; data cells stay square (0).

elevation._note: Apple-philosophy: soft functional elevation defines surfaces (cards float on a barely-there hairline). No decorative or hover-lift shadows.

motion._rules: Animate transform & opacity ONLY. Never `transition: all`. Enter = opacity + translateY(4px); press = scale(0.97). Reduced motion overrides everything (fallback 0ms; opacity-only fades <=120ms permitted).

_designTarget.note: The full A-N Abstract (8 dia cols + Total) must fit at 1366 with the sidebar collapsed; the grid owns horizontal scroll, the page body never does.

muiMapping._note: NEUTRAL-FORWARD: palette.primary = INK (neutral near-black) so incidental MUI usage (controls, selected) reads premium/quiet. palette.secondary = MY HOME RED, reserved for the primary CTA + brand. info = steel (links). Semantics = success/warning/error, STATUS only.
muiMapping.components: Button: disableElevation + disableRipple + textTransform none; the ONE hero CTA per view = color='secondary' variant='contained' (red); other actions = ink outlined/text. Paper flat + soft card shadow. DataGrid rowHeight=36, header=40, tabular-nums, stripe/hover/selected from color.*.dataRow; selected row uses red-50 tint. Focus ring = brand red.

_meta.colorEngine: Material-3 HCT tonal palettes (@material/material-color-utilities v0.4.0); ramps reproducible from seeds in `ramp._note`.
_meta.brand: My Home Group — red #E4002B (accent), black/ink + white. Red used sparingly for premium restraint; danger = distinct maroon-red + icon.
rules: Neutral-forward: ink + zinc-neutral carry ~85% of the UI. My Home red is the ONE accent — brand, primary CTA, active nav, focus, selection tint. Never >1 red CTA per view.
Brand CTA fill = red-600 (white text AA). red-500 fails white-text AA — never use it as a fill behind white.
Danger = maroon-red (ramp danger) + always an icon, so it never reads as the brand red.
Semantic colors (success/warning/danger) are STATUS ONLY. No gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative shadows.
